answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in opal, verified in horizon, and falcon names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 43 submissions per epoch. That is 672 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
